newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-HOLDERS PSG HELD 0-0 AT HOME BY AEK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOLDERS PSG HELD 0-0 AT HOME BY AEK.

text.p: European Cup Winners' Cup holders Paris St Germain were held to a goalless home draw by AEK Athens in the first leg of their quarter-final on Thursday.
The Greek side's goalkeeper Ilias Atmatsidis made three crucial saves from Latin American duo Leonardo and Julio Cesar Dely Valdes to dash PSG's hopes.
Atmatsidis pushed out a point blank header by Panama striker Dely Valdes from a cross by Brazil's Leonardo only 50 seconds into the match, denying off-form PSG the early boost they dearly wanted.
PSG, in deep crisis since January, have not won a match at their Parc des Princes home stadium since early November and now have a mountain to climb in the return leg in two weeks.
